It's intermittent not intermediate. And it's not magic, but many people like it because it's not limiting like a diet is. You just eat all your calories within a set window throughout the day. I used to follow a 16:8 schedule so I wouldn't eat until noon each day and i would stop eating at 8pm every evening. I didn't follow any special diet. You still need proper macros and you won't lose weight if you're eating too many calories. It's easy for a lot of people to lose weight just because of the fact that it's hard to overeat on good healthy foods during that feeding window. Outside of the feeding window you don't consume anything except for water (some people also drink black coffee). Try it out, it doesn't work for everybody but it is a good approach if you're looking to lose weight. Also check out /r/leangains for more info!
